C1076.title: Host Shares New Mobile Hotspot Scam
C1076.summary: Shanghai TV host Tao Chun shared an experience where a stranger asked his friend to enable a mobile hotspot under the pretext of a dead phone needing a top-up. It was later revealed to be a new scam: once the hotspot is shared, scammers can use technical means to obtain phone numbers, bank card details, and SMS verification codes, leading to unauthorized fund transfers or malware installation.
